_comment: Curated airport facts. The scorer needs an explicit UTC offset per timestamp and no feed supplies one, so the offset rules live here: the transition dates are the curated part, and deriving an offset from them needs no timezone database at scoring time. Only airports in scope are listed; anything else abstains, which is the point.

Atlantic/Reykjavik.why: Iceland has never observed summer time

Europe/Istanbul.why: Turkey abolished summer time in 2016 and sits on permanent UTC+3

_review: The rows flagged needs_primary_source were added to cover the European connection points a real JFK-LHR search actually returns. MCT, curfew and inter-terminal figures are curated from published airport and carrier data and are the right shape at roughly the right magnitude; each still wants checking against the airport's own published minimum connection time before a dollar figure built on it is shown to a stranger. AMS, BCN, CDG, EWR, JFK, LHR, LIS, MAD and MXP predate this and carry no flag. Deliberately NOT added: BOS, IAD, ATL, BOG, CMN, TLV and AUH - a JFK-LHR search returns connections through all of them and every one is outside the transatlantic scope, so they go on dropping. CHECKED 2026-09-25: the twelve flagged European rows were researched against the airports' and airlines' own pages (and the national AIPs for curfews) and re-checked by a second reader; corrections are applied and each row keeps the findings under _evidence. Still without a primary source: the minimum connection time everywhere except Frankfurt (60 minutes, Lufthansa), since airports rarely publish one, and process_minutes, which no airport measures (the airports' own advice, usually 3 hours before a long-haul flight, is recorded instead). Shannon's page gave nothing. needs_primary_source therefore stays on these rows.
